title: Advanced digital technologies in sensory and consumer science to increase the adoption of a plant‐based diet
content:
Abstract

The integration of virtual reality (VR), augmented reality (AR), mixed reality (MR), and artificial intelligence (AI) is transforming sensory evaluation, offering innovative methodologies to enhance the perception and experience of plant-based diets and foods. This review explores the current and future potential of these technologies in refining sensory evaluation processes, emphasizing their effects on consumer perception, product development, and marketing strategies. Immersive tools, i.e. VR, AR, and MR technologies, contribute by creating virtual simulations and altering environmental variables, thus offering more controlled and engaging sensory experiences for educating and/or influencing consumers' behavior. AI further supports these approaches by enabling the analysis of large sensory and consumer datasets, helping to identify preference patterns, predict acceptance, and guide the development of plant-based foods. Although the application of these tools to boost the adoption of plant-based diets is still in its early stages, their integration has the potential to significantly advance consumer acceptance and preference for plant-based foods, contributing to healthier diets and environmental sustainability. © 2026 Society of Chemical Industry.
